title: The Law of Small Numbers
coreMove: Use The Law of Small Numbers as the warning label, then make the specific correction before the choice moves forward.
sourcePressure: The frozen TOC and official source notes frame The Law of Small Numbers as a specific decision error around small numbers, sample size, variance. Traceable support includes Daniel Kahneman.
chapterSpecificMisunderstanding: Treating The Law of Small Numbers as generic advice to be smarter, instead of forcing this exact move: use the law of small numbers as the warning label, then make the specific correction before the choice moves forward.

sourceAnchors.name: Daniel Kahneman
sourceAnchors.detail: Daniel Kahneman uses a good example in his book Thinking, Fast and Slow on pages 109 - 113. My story with the shoplifting rates borrows heavily from this.
sourceAnchors.phrasingHint: Daniel Kahneman can appear as a factual pressure point: the reader sees the law of small numbers through evidence, not a decorative citation.
